connector.name: Vidlens MCP by thatsrajan
connector.registryDescription: Video as a queryable local asset for AI agents - 47 tools for YouTube, social, and local media.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package vidlens-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the thatsrajan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
env.description: YouTube Data API v3 key (optional — works without it via fallback scraping)

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google Gemini API key for AI-powered visual descriptions (optional)

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for optional speech-to-text transcription of imported non-YouTube sources

env.name: SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY
env.description: ScrapeCreators API key for optional social trend search across TikTok, Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, and supported endpoints

env.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
env.description: Brave Search API key for optional social/generic video URL discovery
